ways.label: Three Passes, east to west: SH73 to Lake Kaniere Road via the Styx

start.name: Road bridge over the Waimakariri River beside SH73
start.quote: the road bridge over the Waimakariri River

end.name: Carpark at Lake Kaniere Road (Styx exit)
end.quote: the carpark at Lake Kaniere Road

evidence: The Three Passes trip can be started from either end, but the east to west route described here is recommended.
The eastern starting point is at the road bridge over the Waimakariri River, beside State Highway 73 (SH73), 10 km east of Arthur's Pass village.
The Styx is crossed again to an old farm track that leads to the carpark at Lake Kaniere Road.

ways.label: Exit via the Arahura valley

start.name: Road bridge over the Waimakariri River beside SH73
start.quote: the road bridge over the Waimakariri River

end.name: End of the Arahura river track, via Lake Kaniere Road
end.quote: the ends of the Arahura or Styx river tracks

evidence: Parties or individuals that are not confident with river crossing should travel through via the Arahura valley.
On the western side, access to the ends of the Arahura or Styx river tracks is via Lake Kaniere Road, inland from Hokitika.

doubts: Start: the eastern start at the SH73 road bridge over the Waimakariri River has no matching feature or name, so ref is null (the first section is described only by the link to the Carrington Hut Route). End: the text says the carpark at Lake Kaniere Road; the only road ends nearby are on Dorothy Falls Road, and I gave F1 (an unnamed track) as the Styx exit because F2 is the Lake Kaniere Walkway, a different track; the road names do not match, so F1 is not certain. W2 (exit via the Arahura valley) is offered for parties not confident with river crossings, but its route below Harman Hut and its road end are not described, so its end has no ref and no time. The route can also be walked west to east but only east to west is described. Direction is given only as east to west, so null.
